localChanges: With "Settlers wait for size 2" unticked, when Settlers abandon their city of size 1 you're told once, "City abandoned!", where before you were told the city built Settlers and then that it was destroyed (#969).

log: When a city is destroyed, by famine, by conquest or by its own Settlers, the ships and aircraft in it are lost with it, wherever their home city, as in Civ1. Land units in it, and those aboard its ships, stay on the square (civ-clone/web-renderer#969).
A city of size 1 that a Diplomat incites to revolt is now kept, at size 1, with the units it brings over, as in Civ1. Before, it was destroyed (civ-clone/web-renderer#969).

The units a city brings over when a Diplomat incites it to revolt are now homed in that city, and it pays for them, even when it is of size 1, as in Civ1. Before, those from a city of size 1 had no home (civ-clone/web-renderer#969).

With "Settlers wait for size 2" unticked, Settlers that leave a size-1 city behind are homed in the nearest city left only when it is yours. When another player's city is nearer they have no home city, and no city pays for them, as in Civ1 (civ-clone/web-renderer#969).
feat: a unit can be left with no home city (#7)
